name: shader-perlin-noise
title: Perlin Noise
description: Soft Perlin-noise clouds drift across the frame as a duotone fog, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: You want a soft, cloudy, organic backdrop that drifts slowly and stays calm.
A clean scene needs texture without structure or color.
You want a duotone fog: `color_front` clouds over `color_back`.
avoidWhen: You want a smoother, more flowing field: use shader-simplex-noise.
You want neural-web filaments: use shader-neuro-noise.
You need sharp cellular structure: use shader-voronoi.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Color of the gaps between clouds.

variables.label: Proportion
variables.description: How much of the frame the clouds cover.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: How soft the cloud edges are.

variables.label: Persistence
variables.description: How strongly each finer layer shows.

variables.label: Lacunarity
variables.description: How much finer each layer is than the last.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
